title: Seller's Real Property Disclosure Form
description: Nevada requires sellers of residential property (1-4 units) to provide a completed Seller's Real Property Disclosure Form to the buyer. The form covers structural systems, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, environmental hazards, and other known material defects. Must be delivered before or upon execution of the purchase agreement.

required_actions.note: Buyer may rescind within 5 days of receipt if disclosure reveals previously unknown material defects.

title: Duties Owed by a Nevada Licensee
description: Nevada licensees must provide the 'Duties Owed by a Nevada Licensee' form at the first substantive meeting. Dual agency is permitted with written informed consent of both parties. The form must be signed and dated by all parties.

title: Closing Type — Escrow / Title Company
description: Nevada residential closings are conducted through escrow, typically handled by a title company or escrow company. Attorneys are not required. The escrow holder is responsible for ensuring proper document recording, title insurance issuance, and fund disbursement.

required_actions.note: Escrow conducted by title company or licensed escrow company.

title: No State Income Tax — Withholding Exemption
description: Nevada does not impose a state income tax. No state income tax withholding is required at closing for non-resident sellers. However, federal FIRPTA withholding may still apply for foreign sellers.

required_actions.note: No Nevada state income tax withholding required. Verify FIRPTA applicability for foreign sellers.

title: Common-Interest Community (HOA) Resale Package
description: For properties within a common-interest community (HOA/CIC), the seller must provide a resale package including the CC&Rs, financial statements, reserve study, meeting minutes, and any pending special assessments. The association must furnish the resale package within 10 days of request.

required_actions.note: Association has 10 days to provide resale package. Buyer has 5 days to cancel after receipt.
